name: Zamba-7B
attention_variant: hybrid: Mamba backbone with single shared attention module
notes: 7B SSM-transformer hybrid per the Zamba paper (arXiv:2405.16712). Pioneers a unique architecture combining a Mamba backbone with a SINGLE SHARED attention module whose outputs are fed into several transformer blocks, obtaining attention benefits at minimal parameter cost. 'Significantly faster at inference than comparable transformer models and requires substantially less memory for generation of long sequences' (qualitative, no numeric ratio). Trained on 1T tokens. No mainstream inference engine ships a Zamba mode (no llama.cpp LLM_ARCH entry, no vLLM supported-models row as of 2026-10-03). [DANGLING SOURCE FIXED: removed non-existent source 'zamba'.
